title: Non-overlapping Intervals (Min Removals)

monster.name: Chrono Pruner
monster.title: Cutter of Overlapping Spans
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum intervals removed to make remainder mutually non-overlapping!

description: Given an array of intervals `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, return the minimum number of intervals you need to remove to make the rest of the intervals non-overlapping.
hints: Sort by end time (interval scheduling). Keep greedily the interval finishing earliest.
